[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Lewis''' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. When Imperial [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Lariss]] confronted the ruling [[Rajah]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]] during the world's [[Takeover of Virujansi|takeover]] by the Empire, Lewis fulfilled the traditional Virujansi role of [[Conciliator]] for Lariss, pointing out the potential merits of the Rajah's comments during the meeting between the local ruler and the major.

==Biography==
Lewis was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], he held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. When the Empire [[Takeover of Virujansi|took over]] the<ref name="TFtF" /> [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC Virujansi">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Virujansi system/Legends|Virujansi system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Virujansi">{{CSWECite|III|308|Virujansi}}</ref> [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]] with the intention of supplanting that world's ruling [[Rajah]] and the [[Royal Court]] with Imperial officials, Lewis accompanied [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Lariss]], the [[Commanding officer/Legends|leader]] of the Imperial operation.<ref name="TFtF" />

At Virujansi's [[Palace of Splendid Harmony]], the site of the Rajah's [[Ever Radiant Throne|throne]], Lariss intended to decide the fate of the deposed local ruler. Per Virujansi protocol, during Lariss's meeting with the Rajah, Lewis was to perform the traditional Virujansi role of [[Conciliator]]. As such, Lewis's duties included pointing out the possible merits of the Rajah's comments&mdash;as relayed by the Royal Court&mdash;as well as reformulating the comments in a way that could be acceptable to Lariss.<ref name="TFtF" />

{{RPG|"[[To Free the Forgotten]]"}}
Unbeknown to Lariss and the other Imperials present, the Rajah and the Royal Court had previously been secretly spirited away from Virujansi by the Rebel Alliance and were being impersonated by a team of Rebel<ref name="TFtF" /> [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="CSWE Virujansi" /> The undercover Rebel team eventually angered Lariss enough for the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] to order their [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] to the<ref name="TFtF" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC Grehollo">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Grehollo system/Legends|Grehollo system]]</ref> [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Captivity]]&mdash;infiltrating which was actually a part of the Rebels' [[Mission to Captivity|mission]] to rescue [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] valuable to the Alliance.<ref name="TFtF" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Lewis was an individual with a slight build. His speech was rapid yet clear.<ref name="TFtF" />

==Skills and abilities==
Lewis was proficient in the usage of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons, possessed knowledge of various cultures, and was a skilled bargainer.<ref name="TFtF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lewis appeared in "[[To Free the Forgotten]]," a [[roleplaying game]] adventure published in the [[1989]] ''[[The Star Wars Rules Companion]]'' for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The adventure was written by [[Greg Gorden]], who developed it from a story by [[Steve Gilbert]] and [[Michael Stern]].<ref name="TFtF" />

"To Free the Forgotten" presents several options for how the player characters' interaction with Lewis and Major Lariss might proceed. Lariss may eventually order the player characters to be either [[Death/Legends|executed]], confined to house arrest, or exiled to the moon of Captivity. The player characters may also initiate a [[Lightfight|firefight]] with the Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] present. This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="TFtF" />
